calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) as stock_records
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'

SELECT d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) as sales_records
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_year

WITH p05_period AS (
  SELECT fiscal_period, fiscal_year, period_start_date, period_end_date,
         COUNT(DISTINCT calendar_date) as days_in_period,
         weeks_in_period
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 5
),
stock_by_cat AS (
  SELECT dp.category, 
         SUM(fsw.closing_units) as closing_units,
         SUM(fsw.closing_value) as closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
sales_by_cat AS (
  SELECT dp.category,
         SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT s.category,
       s.closing_units,
       sal.total_units_sold,
       p.weeks_in_period,
       ROUND(s.closing_units * p.weeks_in_period / NULLIF(sal.total_units_sold, 0), 2) as weeks_of_cover
FROM stock_by_cat s
LEFT JOIN sales_by_cat sal ON s.category = sal.category
CROSS JOIN p05_period p
ORDER BY s.category

WITH stock_categories AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dp.category
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
),
sales_categories AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dp.category
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
),
all_categories AS (
  SELECT category FROM stock_categories
  UNION
  SELECT category FROM sales_categories
)
SELECT category, 
       CASE WHEN category IN (SELECT category FROM stock_categories) THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END as has_stock,
       CASE WHEN category IN (SELECT category FROM sales_categories) THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END as has_sales
FROM all_categories
ORDER BY category

WITH stock_by_cat AS (
  SELECT dp.category, 
         SUM(fsw.closing_units) as closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
sales_by_cat AS (
  SELECT dp.category,
         SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
combined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(s.category, sal.category) as category,
         COALESCE(s.closing_units, 0) as closing_units,
         COALESCE(sal.total_units_sold, 0) as total_units_sold
  FROM stock_by_cat s
  FULL OUTER JOIN sales_by_cat sal ON s.category = sal.category
)
SELECT category,
       CASE 
         WHEN total_units_sold = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE ROUND(closing_units * 4.0 / total_units_sold, 2)
       END as weeks_of_cover
FROM combined
WHERE closing_units > 0 OR total_units_sold > 0
ORDER BY category
